guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.titl: Crop Wedding Photos for Reels: 9:16 Safe Zones
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.desc: Reframe wedding photos for 9:16 vertical video without cutting off faces, with pixel dimensions and the UI safe areas to keep clear.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.h1: Vertical Crop Guide for Wedding Photos
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.lead: A 9:16 crop removes more than half the width of a landscape photo. Choose the subject before you crop, not after.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.f1v: 1080 × 1920 pixels for a standard vertical story or reel
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.f2v: 9:16 vertical; 4:5 is a gentler option for feed posts
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.f3v: Keep faces out of roughly the top and bottom 250 px
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.f4v: Keep the long edge at 1920 px or larger before cropping
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.s1: Place the face in the upper-middle third and leave room below for captions, buttons and platform UI. For group shots, crop around the group rather than scaling the whole image down — a wide group squeezed into a vertical frame becomes unreadable. If a photo cannot be cropped without losing someone, use a blurred or colour-matched background and fit the full image inside the frame instead.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.s2: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Snapchat all use 9:16 but place interface elements differently, so treat the safe zone as approximate and preview on the actual device. For couples sharing with older relatives on messaging apps, a 4:5 or 1:1 version often survives forwarding better than a full-screen vertical. Check that any text you add is legible in the target language and script direction.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.s3: The common errors are cropping at the original low resolution, cutting through a dress or a joined hand at the frame edge, and putting a caption where the platform puts its own controls. Do not use a zoomed-in crop of a heavily compressed image — vertical video magnifies noise. Export as a high-quality JPEG or PNG, then let the platform compress once.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.q1: What size is a 9:16 wedding story?
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.a1: 1080 × 1920 pixels is the standard vertical canvas used by stories, reels and shorts.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.q2: How do I keep a group photo in a vertical frame?
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.a2: Fit the full image with a blurred or colour-matched background, or create a panning crop. Squeezing a wide group into 9:16 rarely works.
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.q3: Why is text cut off in my story?
guides.crop-wedding-photo-for-reels.a3: Platform UI overlays the top and bottom edges. Keep captions and faces inside a central safe area, roughly 250 px from each end.
